title: Causal evidence for UDM startup, change propagation and recovery
question: Which enforcing decisions account for the late failures and repeated work in the UDM qualification path?
method: Trace retained managed incidents and authoritative source. Replay the actual N42 PDF asset constructor in isolated archived-source copies with the same installed interpreter and retained Integrated parameters. Run targeted change-impact, validator and PDF command-class controls on a private test host.
commands: uv run ci results inspect cfbf7d53d411497b85442167f7d2b70e --view observations --severity ERROR --json
conclusion: The two intervening source edits reproduce the exact Integrated transform asset mismatch through the broad observed graph. Relocation alone preserves the archived asset. Rich admission and the native row-mutation control show that existing domain facts can already drive the required decisions. Material reachability of the changed modules, nested scorer cost, and the per-operation historical recipe determinants remain unresolved.
